sourceSemantics.manager: stake/stakeWithPool pull caller-selected stablecoin into bonded pool, mint rUSDT using floor stakeAmount*1e18/rate; unstake burns caller rUSDT with allowance, computes floor shares*rate/1e18, undelegates if needed and pays actual stablecoin through pool, potentially subtracting redemption shortfall fee. isUnstakePaused defaults true at initialize, owner can change. Stablecoins set is not checked directly in stakeWithPool/unstakeWithPool; no stronger token-safety validation inferred. Pool-specific behavior, current mutable state, selected stablecoin validity and ongoing product maintenance are not asserted.
